Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.commands

package frc.lib.NinjasLib.commands
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    BackgroundCommand
    Holds a single "background task" slot: at most one Command runs through this object at a time, and assigning a new task automatically cancels whatever was previously running in that slot.
    DetachedCommand
    An InstantCommand that hands command off to the CommandScheduler as its own independently-scheduled command, instead of running it inline.
    LoopCommand
    Wraps a command and runs it repeatedly, restarting it (calling end() then initialize() again) each time it finishes, for a fixed number of repeats.
    StateEndCommand
    Runs a sequence of commands one after another, like WPILib's SequentialCommandGroup, but with one key difference: once finished, StateEndCommand.isFinished() keeps returning true instead of the finished status being tied to the current command index.
